value.text: I'm a mariachi, and a good one.

ops.old: The first bar hires a keyboard guy, not him.
ops.new: The bartender already has a full band.

ops.old: Baked coconut and condensed milk mounds, golden at the edges
ops.new: Baked coconut mounds, for the free coconut at the edge of town

ops.old: Mexican lager over lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, chilli salt rim
ops.new: Lager, lime, tomato juice, hot sauce. Azul wants his in a bottle.

ops.old: Domino pours it free. Don't tell Moco.
ops.new: Slow sipping, like the turtle on the highway.
